verdicts.title: A Lie-algebraic approach to the local index theorem on compact homogeneous spaces
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Using a K-theory point of view, Bott related the Atiyah-Singer index theorem for elliptic operators on compact homogeneous spaces to the Weyl character formula. This article explains how to prove the local index theorem for compact homogenous spaces using Lie algebra methods. The method follows in outline the proof of the local index theorem due to Berline and Vergne. verdicts.title: Index theorem for homogenous spaces of Lie groups
